decisions.reason: Product A has high visible commitment through its own website page and is close to the core integrated airport operations, so management will persist to justify the investment.
It builds on established connectivity software, has public mention, and results after one year can still be attributed to temporary causes, supporting persistence.
Although revenue billing is less central to the announced automated operations direction, it was publicly launched and recent, so escalation of commitment favors keeping it.
Monitoring software aligns with data-driven integrated operations and has public website mention, making the firm likely to justify and continue the investment.
It is close to the established offer and supports resource management central to efficient apron operations, with public mention reinforcing commitment.
Controller safety alert service extends traffic control and safety capabilities and, despite only being mentioned, its early results can still be seen as temporary, so management keeps it.
